descriptions.w3d_d24h_logic_message_800c2960: Weapon logic message handler. Message 64 runs the base handler 0x8015fb34 and, on success, the aim start 0x800c2e44, returning 0, or 0x80004005 on failure. Message 66 posts a message when the state +32 is set and runs 0x800c31f0. The cached message 0x804ae6fc checks readiness (0x800c3cf4), returning 0 when not ready, and from state 0 posts two messages, enters state 1 and sets the end time +72 from the engine clock plus the weapon's delay. Message 0x804ae6dc sets state 5 when the weapon at +40 reports ready, otherwise calls 0x8015fd1c. Message 0x804ae724 moves state 3 to 4. Other paths end in the base handler.
